title: How to manage Lease Inquiries
text:
How to manage Lease Inquiries
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Inquiries module.
Click on the +CREATE NEW LEASE INQUIRY button.
A form will appear. Here put the date, sales person name, customer name, contact person (if customer is a company), and then enter the vehicle details. If you want to add more than one vehicle for a single customer, click om the Add Row option below every vehicle detail.
Now, click on the SAVE button.
All inquiries will appear as a list in the window.
You can view, edit, or delete by clicking on the ACTIONS button.
If you have to search a specific inquiry, put lease inquiry number or customer name and date. Then, click on the REFRESH button.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: Define and handle Quotations
text:
Define and handle Quotations
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Quotations module.
Click on the +CREATE NEW LEASE QUOTATION button.
A form will appear. Here put the date, customer name, contact person (if customer is a company), and then enter the vehicle details. If you want to add more than one vehicle for a single customer, click om the Add Row option below every vehicle detail. Also specify rate/month for each year as per demand.
Now, click on the SAVE button.
All quotations will appear as a list in the window.
You can view, edit, or delete by clicking on the ACTIONS button.
If you have to search a specific quotation, put lease quotation number or customer name, internal approval status, customer approval status, and/or date. Then, click on the REFRESH button.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: Manage Master Agreements
text:
Manage Master Agreements
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Master Agreements module.
Here you can see all agreements. For searching a particular agreement, put the details like master agreement number, status, customer, date range, and/or quotation reference number, and then click on REFRESH button.
All Agreements will appear as a list in the window.
You can view details or take print by clicking on the ACTIONS button.
You can also export the data to excel by clicking on the EXPORT TO EXCEL button.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: How to define and manage Agreements
text:
How to define and manage Agreements
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Agreements module.
Click on the +OPEN NEW LEASE AGREEMENT button.
A new window will be opened. Fill details, provisions, clauses, and pre-termination instruction. Then, click on the SAVE button.
All agreements appear in the window as listed.
You can also export the data to excel by clicking on the EXPORT TO EXCEL button or take print by clicking on the REPORT button.
By clicking on the blue ACTIONS button, you can perform a vast set of actions.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: How to set Cost Parameters
text:
How to set Cost Parameters
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Cost Parameters module.
A window will be opened. Go to the top-right side and click on the +CREATE NEW PARAMETERS button.
A small window will pop-up. Choose the cost parameter name and order. Then click on the SAVE button.
That parameter will be enlisted in the window. You can view, edit, and remove by clicking on the ACTIONS button.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: How to manage Cost Settings
text:
How to manage Cost Settings
Go to the panel on the left side and click on the Lease tab.
Scroll down and click on the Cost Settings module.
Click on the +CREATE NEW RECORD button.
A form will appear. Here put the make & model and mark-up percentage.
Now, define each cost particular individually. Adjust rate type or rate and period carefully.
In the end, click on the SAVE button. Cost parameters has been set for a particular make & model.
You can view, edit, or delete each lease record by clicking on the ACTIONS button.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.

title: Monthly Invoicing Rules Settings for Monthly Rental
text:
Monthly Invoicing Rules Settings for Monthly Rental
Monthly Invoicing Rules Settings for Monthly Rental:
This option is related to the monthly invoicing that how do you want to charge your customer if the agreement is monthly basis.
Individual Customers : You can select the invoicing rule according to your company that how you charge your customers. You have to select from 3 invoicing rules. Second option is about the type that do you charge the customer in advance or charge them after the services.
Corporate Customers:
Same options as the individual customers you have to select the invoicing rule and the type.

title: Early Closing of Monthly Rental Setting
text:
Early Closing of Monthly Rental Setting
These settings are related to the monthly invoicing rule.
You have to enter the days from 0 to 6 and if the agreement is closed within 6 days system will charge daily rate.
You have to enter days from 7 to 28 and if the agreement is closed before the month than it will be charged on weekly basis.

title: Rental Agreement Deposit Management
text:
Rental Agreement Deposit Management
While opening an agreement right under the advance amount there is a section for Deposit as well.
You have to enter the deposit amount here. This amount can be used for fines or tolls or can also be adjusted for the due amount.
We can charge this amount throught cash or other means as well.
For deposits management you have to open Vouchers from the left navigation panel.
There you will find the option for Deposits open that and you will see all the deposits taken from the customers.
Click on the action button with the deposit for more options related to that deposit.
You can use this deposit if needed. It can be refunded or extend or can also be transefred to other agreement with same customer.

title: Vehicle Replacement on a rental agreement
text:
Vehicle Replacement On A Rental Agreement
Go to the Rental module from the left navigation panel and open the agreements options.
Here you can see action button with every agreement.
click on that action button and a drop down menu will come select the replace vehicle option.
When you click on it a new window will pop up.
You have to enter the details of the replacement vehicle and press save and by this you can simply replace the vehicle.
Note: Replacement can only be made on open agreements.

text:

UK scs Features
UK Vehicle Safety Check System (SCS) – Features
Before getting started, it would be better to get enough know-how of the App as a stitch on time saves nine. UK Vehicle Safety Check System (SCS) is easier and stress-free.
Though salient features are listed below, yet we are always open to going for customizable solutions. So, you can ask to add, modify, or remove any feature as per your needs.
Dashboard
The dashboard appears as soon as you open the App. So, it is the main interface and is further divided into seven default modules. These seven default modules are;
1. Fleet
2. Inspections
3. Administration
4. Support
5. Data Entry Corrections
6. Customizations
7. Subscriptions & Billing
1. Fleet
The Fleet module allows you to add, edit, and remove vehicles as quickly and easily as you need. It usually deals with the vehicles’ details, management, and current status. A typical “Fleet” module does hold further three options.
. Vehicles
Under the “Vehicles” option, you would be able to add a new vehicle by clicking on the “Create New Vehicle” tab. Also, you can see a list of all the added vehicles in certain a hierarchal fashion. Moreover, it will allow you to sort out vehicles based on the status.
. Vehicle Types
Here you can add and manage vehicle types. By clicking on “Create New Vehicle Type” you will see a comprehensive form to add details and save. These added vehicle types would help you to assign a certain type to a vehicle when adding a new vehicle in the above-mentioned vehicles module.
. Vehicle QR Labels Inspections
Once you have added all the details and type, you can generate distinctive QR labels for each vehicle. Customizable sizes of QR labels will enable you to paste them either on key-chain or the door of your vehicle.
2. Inspection
As the name suggests, this module will enlist all the performed inspections in one place. Moreover, you will be able to choose dynamically between date range and vehicle to see what inspections were carried out. For instance, select a date range like 15/05/2020 – 20/05/2020, click on the “Search” tab and get the list of all the vehicles inspected in the meantime.
3. Administration
The administration module bestows full control over the management of the SCS App. So, go like a professional and grasp like a boss. The administration panel is also divided into further options.
. Branches
UK Vehicle Safety Check System (SCS) is a one-stop-solution. So, it offers you to manage as many branches as you want with this single system. Branches module allows you to add your business branches located at other territories, cities, and even in other countries.
. Safety Check Templates
The safety check process requires different things to inspect and record as per the vehicle type. For instance, what required for a PSV is different than the HGV does. So, to record the observations, you need different templates. Speed – UK Safety Check System (SCS) App offers three default templates that you can use initially.
. Roles
Roles option enables you to create a certain role with specified permissions. So, you are in full control to create a role and apply limitations or authorities.
. Users
Users tab lets you manage all the “users” that are logged in to your system. For instance, you have a manager to perform a daily walk-around vehicle check, you would be able to add him, assigning the role of safety manager from Roles tab, to allow him to use the App effectively.
. Languages
You can choose the language as per your region and native inclination. In this option there a dropdown list of languages of which you can select anyone. Is your language not listed? No problem, you can ask us to add it.
Some additional features are listed below:
Sign Up From Your Smartphone
Another valuable feature is the facility to get signed up from your smartphones. All you need would be to install the Safety Check System (SCS) App from google play store and install it in your device. Then, go for sign up and feed the asked details. Here you are ready to go.
Click Below to go for Speed – Safety Check System (SCS) App on Google Play Store;
UK (SCS) Google Play
Sign Up From Web App
Don’t you want to use a smartphone in your office? No problem. Speed – Safety Check System (SCS) can be signed up from the web browser on your PC as well. So, open the Speed – Safety Check System (SCS) web app in your browser, fill in the Sign-Up form, and it’s all set to start experiencing the automation of vehicle walk-around check.
Click below to go for the Speed – Safety Check System (SCS) Web App:
UK (SCS) Web App
Automatic Form Template As Per DVSA Regulations
Inspection forms are integrated into the Speed – Safety Check System (SCS). These forms are formulated according to the UK’s Driver and Vehicle Safety Agency (DVSA) requirements. So, you can record every essential observation that the authorities demand.
Inspection Templates According To The Vehicle Type
Either you have an HGV, PSV, or a personal Van, Speed – Safety Check System (SCS) provides you with the customized templates. So, the form for HGV inspection would include all the details required for HGV inspection, and so do for PSV and Personal Van.
All Inspections On Web App
Once you have done your inspection with the smartphone App, all the inspection data would be available on the Web App. So, after executing a vehicle’s walk-around check, you have to go for Web App which you can open in any browser either on your smartphone or PC. On the Web App, get Signed-In and have all the inspection data ready to treat in either way.
Modify, Add, Or Remove Any Module
Yes, the App is totally in your hand. It’s inspection forms are fully customizable. So, you can update any module or sub-module as soon as the DVSA modifies its regulations. Moreover, if you find some modules as extra or essential, you would be able to remove or add it respectively.

title: How to define and manage Roles
text:
How to define and manage Roles?
Go to the panel on the left side, scroll down to the Administration module and click on it.
Scroll down and click on the Roles module.
A dashboard will appear on the right side of the panel. Click on the “+CREATE NEW ROLE” button.
Click on the SAVE button.
Click on the ACTIONS button if you want to edit a Role.
Click HERE if you have a query or an issue.
